ctx.x: Yeah, beautiful. And Sidney come in next. He come in after me, and you know, he just packed that thing. He just packed it. And now he says, "Now I want you to go down in Belgium." He sent me down there to Cornat la Zee for 10 weeks at the same salary, which was a pretty good salary. Better than I ever got here.
You didn't go home. You stayed --
